answer_1.quote: We propose a novel approach to improve lexical translation consistency for document-level NMT.

answer_2.quote: We report case-insensitive BLEU score as calculated by the multi-bleu.perl script. ... In terms of LTCR, both +word-link and +CC-loss greatly improve lexical translation consistency.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on 500 sentences randomly selected from our test set... The two annotators are asked to avoid the third option if they could give preference to one of the translations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two translations and choose which is better or if they are equal in overall quality.
